test_inputs.explanation: The agent repeatedly navigated to http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/admin/catalog_product_set/ (seen in Steps 2–11). The filtered URL in Step 10 included a base64 parameter c2V0X25hbWU9RGVmYXVsdA== which decodes to 'set_name=Default', so the visible attribute set name used was 'Default'. I set the wait times to 2s to match the default/typical pauses used during the run.
